description:
Problem: resolving an oracle review thread starts no GitHub Actions run (Actions has no thread-resolution event; PR 3193's attempt failed to parse). A gate failure posted while threads were open stays on the head until a dispatch, a new head or the sweep, and the sweep runs every 3 to 6 hours. make pr-arm refuses while an unresolved thread is open (scripts/pr_arm.py:47-48), so the standard flow resolves the threads, then arms; the armed PR then waits on the stale failure. Agents are told to dispatch the gate by hand (docs/agent/merge-authority.md:63-66). The other two original causes are closed: verdicts dispatch the gate after posting (#3436, oracle-verdict.yml:1002-1011), and cancel-in-progress can no longer strand the required context, because the ruleset requires only the App-posted oracle-gate status, cancelled runs post nothing, plain comments run in their own concurrency group (oracle-gate.yml:41), and every run in a PR's group evaluates live state before posting (oracle_gate.py:128-143, :224-237).

Outcome: make pr-arm and make pr-arm-remote dispatch oracle-gate for the PR and head when the head's latest oracle-gate status is not success, after their existing refusal checks pass, so an armed PR whose threads are resolved gets a fresh gate result without a manual command.

Decision gates:
1. Read the head's oracle-gate state from the combined status (GET repos/<repo>/commits/<head>/status, context oracle-gate). Dispatch only when it is missing, pending, failure or error.
2. A dispatch failure does not block arming: print it and continue, since auto-merge still waits on the gate and the sweep remains the backstop. If the owner prefers refusal, record that and implement it instead.
3. If either arm path cannot dispatch with the caller's existing gh authentication, stop and record why; do not add tokens.

Item guardrails: no change to the gate decision, its triggers, its concurrency, or the statuses it posts; no stand-in; no close and reopen; never clear or re-create auto-merge; touch only scripts/pr_arm.py, scripts/remote_closeout.py, their tests and the docs below. Thread-resolution events and the sweep cadence are out of scope (the sweep-cadence item owns the backstop).

Common guardrails: work only in a linked worktree created by make worktree-create, after make agent-write-preflight; the primary clone is read-only. No SKIP or --no-verify, no stand-in approvals, no ruleset edits or bypasses, no raw gh pr merge. Do not change oracle-gate's App binding (integration 5201041), the oracle decision rule, or the native review-thread-resolution requirement. Do not close and reopen, mass-rerun or rebase other pull requests. No explanatory comments or docstrings in code; commits, PR bodies and docs carry no tracker item IDs or session labels.
